meta.vault_note: 2026+ fights are the sealed vault (docs/BACKLOG.md hidden-data protocol): never scored here; their snapshot factors are pre-fight outputs only
meta.model: counts: E[y] = E * L * exp(c + o_X + d_Y); probabilities: logit p = b + c + a_X + g_Y; fit walk-forward on every UFC fight with stats since 2001-01-01 before each prediction date, weights 0.5^(days/half_life), conjugate pseudo-data priors of k exposure units at the fighter's own baseline (exactly the engine's shr() when opponent effects are zero)
meta.k_unit_note: count k are exposure units of each family: dAtt distance minutes, cAtt and ctrl fight minutes, gAtt top minutes, tdAtt standing minutes, sub ground minutes, kd landed head strikes, topSkill takedowns landed; binomial k are attempts. *_engine_units divide by the league position share the engine multiplies its k by (kPM * L.dist etc.)
meta.factors: per side, relative to src/engine3.js fighterRates on the same S (backtest S for snapshots, fighters.json S with live priors of his division for the roster), params3 k values above. Rates (dAtt dAttAg cAtt cAttAg gAtt gAttAg tdAtt tdAttAg ctrl octrl topSkill escWeak sub subAg pow chin) multiply R.<field>; tdAcc / tdAccAg multiply the odds of R.tdAcc / R.tdAccAg; acc / accAg (head, body, leg) multiply accuracy odds: R.accSh[t] += log(acc[t]), R.accAgSh[t] += log(accAg[t]). Factors include half the fitted level c per side and a calibration-neutral term so the engine's global scales tuned on raw rates stay valid. Task names: att_adj = dAtt (cAtt, gAtt), def_adj = accAg (and dAttAg), acc_adj = acc, kdpow_adj = pow, chin_adj = chin, td_adj = tdAtt and tdAcc, tddef_adj = tdAccAg.
meta.sched: roster only: exposure-weighted mean of what his opponents allowed relative to average (> 1 = he faced leaky opponents, his raw numbers are inflated): dAtt attempts allowed, accH head-accuracy odds allowed, kd opponents' chin (KD per head landed allowed), tdAtt takedown attempts allowed, tdAcc takedown-success odds allowed, ctrl control allowed

over_mlrates.note: baseline = ML rate x exposure (fight minutes for counts, landed head strikes for kd, attempts for probabilities) with a level fit on 2019-2023; + oppadj adds x = log(final/engine raw) with coefficient fit on 2019-2023; gain = test deviance reduction 2024-25, 95% fight-cluster bootstrap

recommendation.rule: engine path: apply the snapshot / roster factors of families with engine_path_lambda > 0 (the factors already include their lambda); set the others to 1. ML path (src/ml/mlrates.js targets): multiply each ML target by (F_off,X * F_def,Y)^ml_path_beta (odds for probabilities); topSkill/escWeak multiply the engine's R directly in both paths

roster_recipe.note: factors for a bout in division D (verification pass): F = side_factors(family, eff[0], eff[1], c=0, R_D, L_D, kappa, lambda), i.e. counts F_off = (Lbar_D exp(eff_off) / R_D.off)^lambda * kappa, probabilities F = exp(lambda (eff - shift_D) + kappa'); R_D, L_D = engine fighterRates / league at D's priors. roster[slug] factors use the fighter's own division; for a cross-division bout use tools/oppadj.py factors_at_division (the backtest factors are built at the bout division).

engine_backtest.note: engine v3 (src/engine3.js + src/params3.js as of the run) via tools/oppadj_engine.js; plain = engine raw shrunk rates; adj = the same rates times this file's snapshot factors; ml = mlrates out-of-fold / dev rates through src/ml/mlrates.js applyToMatchup; ml_adj = ML targets x (F_off,X F_def,Y)^beta (ml_beta_used); same seeds for every configuration, both corner orders averaged; winner log loss on decisive fights; 7-bin = [A KO, A SUB, A DEC, DRAW, B DEC, B SUB, B KO]; 2026+ never simulated
engine_backtest.run_note: run 14:30-14:56 UTC on the live src/ (before the frozen-copy option existed): src/engine3.js (judging shared-noise change at 14:31) and src/params3.js (4.0.0-dev -> 4.0.0-selfcal-pre2024 calibration scales, same k values) were edited by other work during the run, so the 2019-2023 period ran on the earlier engine and 2024-2025 on the later one; every comparison is paired within one period and one process, so the deltas are valid, the absolute levels of the two periods are not comparable. Pooled numbers were not computed for this run.

pooled_2019_2025_paired.note: pooled 2019-2025 paired deltas from the first run (each delta is within one period and one engine version; absolute levels mix the two engine versions), computed post hoc from the run outputs

engine_backtest_recommended.note: engine v3 (frozen copy of src/engine3.js, params3.js, ml/mlrates.js at the start of the run; hashes above) via tools/oppadj_engine.js; plain = engine raw shrunk rates; adj = the same rates times this file's snapshot factors; ml = mlrates out-of-fold / dev rates through src/ml/mlrates.js applyToMatchup; ml_adj = ML targets x (F_off,X F_def,Y)^beta (ml_beta_used); same seeds for every configuration, both corner orders averaged; winner log loss on decisive fights; 7-bin = [A KO, A SUB, A DEC, DRAW, B DEC, B SUB, B KO]; 2026+ never simulated

volk_gaethje.note: A = Volkanovski, B = Gaethje; pA = P(Volkanovski wins); bins as above; fighters.json profiles and live priors; recommended factor set
